annual_report.business: Camlin Fine Sciences Limited is an integrated specialty chemicals company engaged in research, development, manufacturing, and marketing of specialty chemicals, ingredients, and additive blends across Shelf-Life Solutions, Aroma Ingredients, Performance Chemicals, and Health & Wellness verticals, serving food, feed, animal nutrition, pet food, fragrance, pharma, and industrial sectors globally.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Overall business strategy of focused product portfolio, deeper customer penetration coupled with a strong team and geographical reach & expansion, lends confidence to the management for the growth of the Blends business with a guidance of ~20% CAGR over the next 2–3 years.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Exposure in group entities (carrying amount of investments, loans, advances, trade & other receivables net of payables) accounts for 34% of total assets as at March 31, 2026; recoverability dependent on future cash flows requiring significant management judgement.

key_risks: Increased local competition and subdued global demand impacting gross margins
Spiralling input costs, extensive competition, predatory pricing, and expected global capacities in Diphenols
Pricing pressure and increased domestic competition in Specialty Ingredients (Straights portfolio)
Financial stress from margin pressure, fall in sale prices, international tariff impacts, and inventory accumulation
High exposure to group entities (34% of total assets) with recoverability dependent on subsidiaries' future cash flows
Exceptional items including provisions for loan/interest receivable, acquisition costs, labour code impacts, fire losses, and impairment losses
Liquidation of CFS Europe SpA and winding down of European diphenol operations

latest_guidance.statement: FY28 normalized EBITDA margin target of 12-14%

Outlook FY27 Aroma anticipate improvement in volumes and realisations over coming quarters
